headerDisplay: Pulse-Eight USB-CEC Apple TV Remote Bridge for Homebridge
footerDisplay: Captures Apple TV Siri Remote HDMI-CEC Volume Up, Volume Down, and Mute presses via cec-client (libcec) and exposes them as native HomeKit StatelessProgrammableSwitch buttons, with optional direct Trinnov TCP port 44100 control via homebridge-trinnov discovery.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name for this platform instance in Homebridge.

_bridge.title: Child Bridge
_bridge.description: Optional Homebridge Child Bridge settings (managed via Bridge Settings in Homebridge UI).

cecClientPath.title: cec-client Executable Path
cecClientPath.description: Path to the libcec cec-client binary (e.g. 'cec-client', '/opt/homebrew/bin/cec-client', or '/usr/bin/cec-client').

portPath.title: Pulse-Eight Serial Port (Optional)
portPath.description: Leave blank to let cec-client auto-detect the Pulse-Eight adapter, or specify an explicit serial device path.

osdName.title: CEC OSD Name
osdName.description: Device name advertised on the HDMI-CEC bus (up to 14 characters).

hdmiPort.title: HDMI Port Number (Optional)
hdmiPort.description: Optional HDMI port number (-p) if cec-client needs an explicit port for your receiver/switch.

holdMode.title: Volume Hold Behavior (HomeKit Switches)

oneOf.title: Continuous Repeat (Emit Single Press every 150ms while held)

holdMode.description: How holding Volume Up or Volume Down on the Siri Remote maps to HomeKit StatelessProgrammableSwitch events. Direct Trinnov volume control always steps continuously while held.

holdDelayMs.title: Hold Threshold Delay (ms)
holdDelayMs.description: Milliseconds a volume button must be held before triggering Long Press or starting repeat ticks.

holdRepeatMs.title: Hold Repeat Interval (ms)
holdRepeatMs.description: Repeat interval in milliseconds while Volume Up or Volume Down is held.

holdSafetyMs.title: Hold Safety Timeout (ms)
holdSafetyMs.description: Maximum duration before automatically stopping a hold if a CEC release packet (0x45) is dropped.

rescanIntervalSec.title: Periodic CEC Bus Rescan Interval (seconds)
rescanIntervalSec.description: Optional interval to periodically re-scan the HDMI-CEC bus for newly connected Apple TVs (0 = only scan on startup and unknown device traffic).

trinnovControl.title: Direct Trinnov Volume Control (TCP 44100)

oneOf.title: Auto (Send directly to Trinnov TCP 44100 when discovered or configured)
Enabled (Always route volume/mute to Trinnov TCP 44100)

trinnovControl.description: Controls whether CEC Volume Up, Volume Down, and Mute presses are sent directly to a Trinnov processor over TCP port 44100 using homebridge-trinnov discovery or Homebridge config.

trinnovHost.title: Trinnov IP / Hostname Override (Optional)
trinnovHost.description: Leave blank to auto-discover the Trinnov IP from homebridge-trinnov (homebridge-trinnov-discovery.json / HTTP discovery) or Homebridge config.json.

trinnovVolumeStepDb.title: Trinnov Volume Step (dB)
trinnovVolumeStepDb.description: Volume change in dB sent via 'dvolume' on each tap or hold repeat tick (e.g. 0.5 or 1).

trinnovMuteAction.title: Trinnov Mute Action
trinnovMuteAction.description: Action sent to Trinnov when the Siri Remote Mute button is pressed.

trinnovDiscoveryUrl.title: homebridge-trinnov Discovery URL (Optional)
trinnovDiscoveryUrl.description: Optional HTTP endpoint exposed by homebridge-trinnov when running on a separate host/container without shared Homebridge storagePath.

trinnovClientId.title: Trinnov Client ID
trinnovClientId.description: Identifier sent in the Trinnov 'id <name>' handshake.

trinnovIdleTimeoutMs.title: Trinnov Idle Disconnect Timeout (ms)
trinnovIdleTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds of inactivity before sending 'bye' and closing the Trinnov TCP socket (0 = keep connected).

devices.title: Apple TV Filters & Overrides (Optional)
devices.description: By default, all Apple TVs found by 'cec-client scan' are exposed automatically. Add entries here only if you want to filter specific Apple TVs, customize their HomeKit names, or override their Trinnov target.

logicalAddress.title: CEC Logical Address (Hex)
logicalAddress.description: Match discovered Apple TV by CEC logical address nibble (e.g. '4' for Playback 1, '8' for Playback 2, 'b' for Playback 3).

physicalAddress.title: CEC Physical Address
physicalAddress.description: Match discovered Apple TV by HDMI physical address (e.g. '6.0.0.0').

osdName.title: Discovered CEC OSD Name
osdName.description: Match discovered Apple TV by its CEC OSD string.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Set to false to ignore this Apple TV.

trinnovEnabled.title: Enable Direct Trinnov Control for this Apple TV
trinnovEnabled.description: Set to false to prevent this Apple TV's remote from sending direct TCP commands to Trinnov.

trinnovId.title: Target Trinnov Processor ID / Name (Optional)
trinnovId.description: Match a specific Trinnov processor from homebridge-trinnov discovery by its id or name.
